import re

def sanitize_control_characters(text: str) -> str:
    """Removes invisible control characters (such as \x18) while preserving standard whitespace."""
    # Matches ASCII control characters from 0 to 31 excluding tab (\x09), newline (\x0a), and carriage return (\x0d)
    pattern = re.compile(r'[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]')
    return pattern.sub('', text)
